test_results.observation: The public upload branch harness observed created, non-terminal idempotency replay, non-terminal fingerprint deduplication, terminal replay and terminal deduplication with status and ingestion_job_id coherent with one durable job. Filename-only identity, Workspace and operation scope, immutable conflict binding, K2 replay, same-fingerprint upload convergence and conflicting-fingerprint upload/reprocess races were deterministic and produced no extra authoritative generation.

All six public states were constructed and polled. Attempt counts/max budget, literal retry timestamp, absent non-retry timestamp, safe terminal metadata, successful result, exact serving tuples, polling hint, no-store and lifecycle timestamp progression were observed. Authentication and Workspace-scoped not-found probes returned safe results before unauthorized lookup.

The adversarial PostgreSQL retrieval probe returned only Workspace/active-set/configuration-authorized candidates with candidate_k applied at the retrieval boundary. Processing and terminal failure polls retained the previous serving tuple, historical evidence stayed active-only, and the current worker/tracer probes preserved immutable configuration selection.

Reprocess authorization order, invalid mode/selector rejection, historical rejection side-effect freedom, audit projection, explicit selector snapshot and current-mode request replay were observed. Rejected paths created no generation and did not enqueue worker work; accepted audit/idempotency/generation decisions were durable and scoped.

Exact-tuple reuse and stale-CAS supersession preserved durable attempt state, replacement metadata, current/active/served pointers and old-generation immutability. Independent duplicate delivery and transition replay did not repeat handler/provider work or create duplicate rows.

The connected multi-page PDF tracer independently established physical page 2 and returned server-resolved page 2, inclusive/exclusive offsets and the exact normalized excerpt/checksum path. Generation used Evidence Aliases, and the pinned legacy citation baseline remained unchanged.

The connected upload-to-worker-to-poll-to-cited-answer flow resolved the citation to the exact generated Document Version/Chunk. Tenant retrieval and no-qualified-evidence refusal preserved the frozen public payload with zero Generation Provider calls and a generation-not-called trace. Changed paths contain no SSE/progress/UI surface.
